description: Architecture rules for the tacacs-rs workspace. The allowlist names the production workspace edges that Cargo can resolve. The guards preserve external and transitive dependency boundaries. Rules track the real workspace packages.

forbidden_dependency_guards.name: kubesonic-adapter
forbidden_dependency_guards.description: Keep the KubeSONiC adapter independent of daemon lifecycle and IPC hosting.

forbidden_dependency_guards.name: pure-protocol
forbidden_dependency_guards.description: Check pure protocol dependencies. The protocol package stays free of async runtime, TLS, IPC, store, and higher-layer workspace code.

forbidden_dependency_guards.name: provider-neutral-credentials
forbidden_dependency_guards.description: Check provider-neutral credential dependencies. Credential resolution stays provider neutral and free of transport or schema code.

forbidden_dependency_guards.name: schema-free-networking
forbidden_dependency_guards.description: Check schema-free networking dependencies. The network client stays free of IPC, store, configuration, credential, and agent code.

forbidden_dependency_guards.name: configuration-adapter
forbidden_dependency_guards.description: Check configuration adapter dependencies. The configuration library keeps clap, IPC, store, and higher-layer code out of its production graph.

forbidden_dependency_guards.name: ipc-independent-agent
forbidden_dependency_guards.description: Check IPC-independent agent dependencies. The agent runtime does not own the IPC transport in production.

forbidden_dependency_guards.name: runtime-independent-ipc
forbidden_dependency_guards.description: Check runtime-independent IPC dependencies. The IPC crate does not depend on the agent, network client, configuration, store, or credential code.

forbidden_dependency_guards.name: unix-socket-leaf
forbidden_dependency_guards.description: Check Unix socket ownership dependencies. The Unix socket crate stays a small leaf with no protocol, transport, schema, or IPC code.

forbidden_dependency_guards.name: supported-core
forbidden_dependency_guards.description: Check supported core dependencies. The production closure of the workspace default members excludes the experimental crates, Rego, and libseccomp.
